title: C: File I/O
description: Write data to a file and read it back using C file I/O functions.

steps.title: Write and Read a File
steps.description: Write a program that writes 'Hello, File!' to 'output.txt' using fprintf, then reads it back using fgets and prints it. Use simulated file operations since the environment is sandboxed: just print what would be written and read.
hints: Simulate: print 'Writing: Hello, File!' then 'Reading: Hello, File!'
